author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1M MPTCP-facing servers being scanned. Also Metabase.

author: harundotdev
text: OpenAI says an AI pipeline found 948 Linux kernel bugs that let a normal user become root, with working exploits, in one run costing about $1.2M.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack on AI pentest tool tomicdd/artex Docker image (~7,946 pulls): backdoor only in image; Docker removed images Nov 5.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Google reports LLMJacking: compromised credentials used to run generative AI jobs on enterprise Google Cloud LLM accounts, bills over $100,000/day.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes vulnerability patched: AI agents could access host files via prompt injection. Update to v0.51.0.

author: liuziqi529
text: Warp disclosed a vendor breach that may expose AI agent logs (~1% users). Rotate keys the agent used.

author: gen_analysis
text: IPI Bench released: frontier models remain broadly susceptible to indirect prompt injection in realistic workplace agent tasks.

author: Priosweep
text: CISA due date for WordPress CVE-2026-119977 is Nov 6. Race condition in core upgrades; actively exploited; fixed in 7.1.4.

author: cordobahq
text: CISA added actively exploited Apple CVE-2024-27834 (PAC bypass) to KEV. Patch by Nov 18.

author: itsalreadywhen
text: Zyxel GS1900 patch didn't close actively exploited zero-day CVE-2026-107441; APT29 iOS/Android watering-hole chains; Debian/Ubuntu APT MitM flaw.

author: Sujeet
text: Metabase has an unauthenticated SQL injection being actively exploited.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited critical RCE flaw.

author: undercode_news
text: Cisco revises emergency fix for actively exploited Secure Email Gateway vulnerability granting unauthenticated root.

author: SmarterMSP
text: Critical Brotli flaw actively exploited, could enable RCE across many applications.

author: Surefire_Cyber
text: Two critical PHP vulnerabilities, PHP2Shell, reportedly actively exploited.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Alpine Linux SSH auth bypass: musl crypt() makes OpenSSH accept any >256-byte password for passwordless accounts, including root.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: NTT DOCOMO detected unauthorised external access affecting DOCOMO Online Shop and My docomo servers.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
